Hawaii Vacation Packing List

Based on Emma Johnson's Hawaii Vacation (June 10-20, 2024)

Essential Items:
- Swimwear
- Sunscreen
- Hiking gear
- Casual outfits
- Camera
- Travel documents

Additional Recommended Items:
- Beach towel
- Sunglasses
- Hat or cap
- Light rain jacket
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Flip flops/sandals
- Reusable water bottle
- Snorkeling gear (or plan to rent)
- Insect repellent
- First aid kit
- Chargers for electronic devices
- Power adapter if needed
- Small backpack for day trips
- Waterproof phone case
